content:
# New client onboarding workflow — human-readable mirror of the
# executable Dynamic Workflow registered as "client-onboarding".
# Run it with: run-workflow workflowId="client-onboarding" inputData={...}

workflow:
  name: client-onboarding
  version: 1.0.0
  description: >
    Executable onboarding workflow triggered manually after contract
    signature / sales handoff. Completes within a 10-business-day SLA
    and produces a final summary report with per-step status.

inputs:
  required:
    - name: client_name
      description: Legal or trade name of the client being onboarded.
    - name: primary_contact_name
      description: Full name of the client's primary point of contact.
    - name: primary_contact_email
      description: Email address of the primary contact (validated for plausibility).
    - name: service_scope
      description: Description of the services being delivered; drives account provisioning.
  optional:
    - name: kickoff_target_date
      description: Preferred kickoff meeting date; if omitted, the next business-week slot is proposed.

steps:
  - id: validate_client_info
    name: Validate Client Info
    description: Check all required fields are present and the contact email is plausible.
    on_fail: downstream steps are skipped.

  - id: provision_accounts
    name: Provision Accounts & Access
    description: >
      Derive client accounts and access grants from service_scope and record
      them. Skipped if validation failed.

  - id: schedule_kickoff
    name: Schedule Kickoff Meeting
    description: >
      Use kickoff_target_date if valid; otherwise propose the next business-week
      slot. Flags the 10-business-day SLA. Skipped if validation failed.

  - id: conduct_kickoff_confirm
    name: Conduct Kickoff & Confirm
    description: >
      Record that the kickoff happened and outcomes were confirmed with the
      primary contact. Skipped if validation failed.

  - id: handoff_to_delivery
    name: Handoff to Delivery Team
    description: >
      Mark handoff complete and record the delivery team's acknowledgement.
      Skipped if validation failed.

  - id: assemble_report
    name: Assemble Summary Report
    description: Produce the final report; the report is the workflow's run result.

outputs:
  client_name: string
  overall_status: completed | blocked | incomplete
  all_steps_passed: boolean
  handoff_acknowledged: boolean
  sla_within_10_business_days: boolean
  steps: array of 5 per-step results (id, status: pass/fail/skipped, detail)
  summary: string

completion_criteria:
  - All 5 process steps pass.
  - Handoff acknowledged by the delivery team.
  - Summary report with per-step status produced as the run output.
